coverage_explanation: Verifies the specific initial calendar date and corresponding weekday from the supplied RTC initialization. Button navigation is not asserted: the requirement leaves hold-repeat and debounce semantics unspecified, and the available LCD checks cannot compare navigation direction relative to an observed date without imposing a one-step-per-pulse policy. LCD text checks also cannot verify size, color, coordinates, removal of obsolete pixels, or RTC begin-result handling. The supplied RTC starts far from midnight, so this finite run does not verify an RTC-driven date rollover.
assumptions: The host RTC honors the supplied DS1307 initTime, 2025-05-10T02:04:00, and advances normally. The input schema has no RTC-setting operation.
Explicit circuit wiring overrides bench defaults: pin 3 is the previous-date button and pin 2 is the next-date button; both are externally pulled down, released LOW and pressed HIGH.
LCD checks observe API text output rather than pixel appearance or cursor coordinates.
The reference uses debounced rising-edge navigation as one permissible implementation choice. The tests do not require that policy, an exact debounce duration, or any particular hold-repeat behavior.
No repeated text emission is required: a display may retain unchanged date and weekday text without printing it again.

checks.requirement_quote: Also show days of the week
